dsh-observation-journal is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Zero-touch runtime telemetry for DSH: every session auto-writes task, model tier, tools, failures, duration, status into a human-readable journal with a stats section (pure observer — no tools, no LLM calls, no injection).

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-9fb596d247bbe88744e0.html
